newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keisei Electric slides on stop-loss sales.
newsitem.headline: Keisei Electric slides on stop-loss sales.

text.p: Shares in Keisei Electric Railway Co Ltd slid on Monday morning, prompted mainly by stop-loss selling, traders said.
The share price of the railway company lost 30 yen to 785 yen by 0150 GMT, the fifth-largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Keisei Electric shares had been cheered by the new listing of Oriental Land Co Ltd, the Tokyo Disneyland operator, as Keisei is one of big shareholders in Oriental Land. But the continuing fall in Oriental Land shares discouraged the Keisei shares, traders said.
The share price of Oriental Land were down 80 yen at 8,220 yen by 0157 GMT on Monday, on volume of 272,700 shares.
